LanguageData.HH.Underworld.GateClosed: Not available in this game: the Underworld module is off, or the content intensity does not allow it (Settings, Modules).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoomDoorInfo: Only staff, colonists and shady guests can open this door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoom.NoOrdinaryDoor: Not a back room yet: this room also has an ordinary door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoom.NoOutside: Not a back room yet: the room is open to the outside.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoom.NoRoom: Not a back room yet: no room behind this door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoom.Off: A plain door: the underworld is switched off (module or Cozy content).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoom.Status.NotBuilt: Build a room whose only doors are back room doors.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Facility.Off: The underworld is switched off (module or Cozy content).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Offer.Gone: The offer is off: the boat or the gang is gone.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Titl: The back room was found out
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Text: A respectable guest opened the wrong door and saw what the house keeps behind it. By evening everyone in town will know.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Title: Leaked ledger
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Text: A page of the fence's tally has found its way into the wrong hands. The goods are traced back to your counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.SecretCasinoRumour: Word has gone round that your house hides a casino for people who do not talk about it. High rollers are looking for the door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.HonourAmongThieves: A gang speaks well of your house in the places where it counts.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Animals.Desc: Animals of your colony may fight here.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Volunteers.Desc: Colonists who like a fight (bloodlust or good melee) may volunteer. Volunteers never fight to the death.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Prisoners.Desc: Prisoners may be sent into the pit. Adults only.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Lethal.Desc: Bouts between prisoners and animals only end when one of them is down. Never for volunteers.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.StartNow.Desc: Pick two fair fighters now and let the guests bet.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.ArenaOpen: Arena open or too big: close the fence.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.BoutAnnounced: A bout in the pit: {0} against {1}. Bets are open.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Won: {0} wins the bout. The house keeps {1} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Draw: The bout ends without a winner. All stakes are returned.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Inspect: Stock: {0} items worth {1} silver. Cash box: {2} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Fund.Desc: Move silver from the till into the fence's cash box, up to the limit in the settings.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Funded: {0} silver moved into the cash box.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Exposed: The goods came from {0}, and they know where they ended up.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Stock: Stock: {0} items worth {1} silver. Cash box: {2} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Why.TillEmpty: the till and the cash box are empty
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.TakeOut.Desc: Put the whole stock on the floor next to the counter. The goods become ordinary items your colony can use or sell; the fence forgets where they were stolen.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.TookOut: {0} stacks put next to the counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Status.NotBuilt: Build a fence counter: gangs sell it their loot and buy from its stock.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Status.Waiting: Waiting for a gang with goods to sell.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Title: A gang at the door
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Text: {0} people from {1} arrive quietly, nod at the staff and ask for the back room. They have money and they expect no questions.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Title: A friendly offer
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Text: The leader of the gang from {0} leans on your counter. "A fine house. It would be a shame if something happened to it. For {1} silver we make sure nothing does."
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Letter.How: Select {0} to pay or to refuse. The offer stands for {1} hours; letting it run out counts as a refusal.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Pay.Desc: Pay from the till. The gang leaves you alone and its faction thinks a little better of you.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Refuse.Desc: Refuse. The gang's faction takes it badly and loses goodwill.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Refused: You showed the gang the door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Expired: You did not answer the gang: they take it as a no.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Why.NoFacility: no back room, fence counter or fight pit
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Why.NoPawns: no gang members could be found
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Status.NotBuilt: Gangs come once you have a back room, a fence counter or a fight pit.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Status.Retry: The last gang could not come: {0}. Next try in {1}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Tour.IntelText: After an hour with {0} the gang left a note on the counter: a name, a place, a day. Somebody out there is planning something, and now you know a little more.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Title: A crate at the dock
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Text: A shuttle with its lights out has set down at the dock. A voice offers {0} items worth about {1} silver for {2}. No questions, no receipt.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.InspectText: An imperial patrol saw the lights at your dock and has written it down.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Letter.How: Select the dock to buy the crate or to send the boat away. It waits {0} hours, then it leaves.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Buy.Desc: Pay from the till. The crate is dropped next to the dock.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Decline.Desc: Send the boat away. Nothing else happens.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Bought: The crate is yours: {0} silver from the till.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Declined: The boat left without a deal.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Left: The boat at the dock did not wait any longer and left.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Waiting: A boat is waiting at the dock: {0} items for {1} silver (leaves in {2}).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Next: Next landing: at night, in about {0}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Status.NotBuilt: Build a smuggler's dock: boats land at night with cheap contraband.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Title: A hunting party
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Text: {0} hunters arrive with rifles and money. They paid {1} silver for the ground, and {2} animals were released into it.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Prisoners.Desc: Let hunters hunt a prisoner released into the ground. Dark content only, with a fitting ideology.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.GatePrecept: The colony's ideology does not allow this.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathTitle: A person died in the hunt
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathText: {0} did not survive the hunt. His people will hear of it, and so will everyone who was watching.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.FreedText: {0} lasted the time and walks free. The hunters went home angry; his faction will hear how it was done.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Open: Open: close the fence around the hunting ground.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Closed: No hunts: the module or the content intensity does not allow them.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Status.NotBuilt: Research the hunt, then put a hunting ground marker inside a closed fence of at least {0} tiles.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.Sold: {0} organs collected at the clinic counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderText: A buyer wants a {0} within {1} days and pays a premium.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderDone: The order for a {0} was filled.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderMissed: The order for a {0} was not filled in time.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.Status.NotBuilt: Research the black clinic and build its counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.Status.Waiting: Organs left on the counter are collected at night (23:00 to 04:00).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Lounge.Status.NotBuilt: Put a venue sign of type drug lounge into a room with two couches or armchairs.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Lounge.Status.NotReady: The lounge is not set up yet.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Lounge.Status.Closed: Closed now: the lounge opens in the evening.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Title: Underworld
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Weights: Arrival weights: respectable x{0}, outlaws x{1}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats1: Fight pit: {0} bouts, {1} bets, house take {2} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats3: Lounge sessions {0}, gang visits {1}, landings {2}, hunts {3}, organs {4}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.HighRollers: A rumour about a secret casino is drawing high rollers.
